import json,time,resource,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from pipeline.projection_visibility import measured_projection_visibility
from pipeline.point_mask_relation import point_mask_relation
start=time.monotonic()
with np.load('/tmp/native-input/native.npz',allow_pickle=False) as a:cp=a['camera_projection'].astype(np.int64)
with np.load('/tmp/sam/masks.npz',allow_pickle=False) as a:masks=a['masks'][:,0]
p=np.loadtxt('/tmp/projected/projection.csv',delimiter=',');n=len(cp);assert p.shape==(n,5);np.testing.assert_array_equal(p[:,0],np.arange(n));slots=cp.reshape(n,2,3)
depths=np.full((n,2),np.nan);valid=(slots[:,:,0]==1)&(slots[:,:,1]>=0)&(slots[:,:,1]<1920)&(slots[:,:,2]>=0)&(slots[:,:,2]<1280)&(p[:,1,None]==1)&(p[:,4,None]>0)
depths[valid]=np.broadcast_to(p[:,4,None],(n,2))[valid]
# Independent sorted pixel/depth frontier: first depth in each lexicographic group.
ri,si=np.nonzero(valid);keys=slots[ri,si];z=depths[ri,si];order=np.lexsort((z,keys[:,2],keys[:,1],keys[:,0]));sortedkeys=keys[order];first=np.r_[True,np.any(sortedkeys[1:]!=sortedkeys[:-1],axis=1)];group=np.cumsum(first)-1;nearest=z[order][np.flatnonzero(first)][group];ref_min=np.empty(len(order));ref_min[order]=nearest
r={'points':n,'masks':len(masks),'valid_front_slots':len(ri),'distinct_measured_pixels':int(first.sum()),'pixel_collisions_excess_slots':int(len(ri)-first.sum()),'tolerance_diagnostics':{},'scope':'sparse measured-depth diagnostic using static-world approximate depth and supplied pixels; no physical visibility promotion'}
for tol in [0.,.1,.5,1.]:
 actual=measured_projection_visibility(cp,depths,{1:(1280,1920)},depth_tolerance_m=tol);ref=np.zeros((n,2),bool);ref[ri,si]=z<=ref_min+tol;np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual['supported'],ref)
 relation=point_mask_relation(cp,masks,camera=1,visibility=actual['supported']);assert relation['points']==n
 r['tolerance_diagnostics'][str(tol)]={'nearest_measured_slots':int(ref.sum()),'behind_measured_slots':int((valid&~ref).sum()),'mask_incidence_points':int(relation['projected_hits'].any(1).sum()),'mask_nearest_measured_points':int(relation['visible_hits'].any(1).sum()),'reason_counts':{str(k):int(v) for k,v in zip(*np.unique(actual['reasons'],return_counts=True))}}
r['elapsed_seconds']=time.monotonic()-start;r['peak_rss_kib']=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss
Path('/outputs/check.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2));print(json.dumps(r))

validation.scope: sparse measured-depth diagnostic using static-world approximate depth and supplied pixels; no physical visibility promotion
